content:
alex: FYI vendor just confirmed a partial RMA for batch #G-3389, 12 units affected, serials mismatch on 6 of them. They want to split replacements EU/US.
maria: Ugh. Our EU pool is already down 8 GPUs this week, that hits Dedicated SLAs for two customers.
lee: Can we borrow from US spares and ship? Network egress and customs often add 3-5 business days.
sam: Shipping note: air bridge (express) ETA ~48-72h but customs docs + HS codes will add friction. Need AWB and photos for insurance.
alex: Vendor offered two options: (A) expedited air for all 6 EU replacements at vendor cost + 30% expedite surcharge reimbursed later, (B) loaner units shipped from vendor EU depot (6 units) with 14d replacement SLA. Vendor says loaners are ready.
nexasupply-rep: Confirming — loaners available in AMS depot, can ship next-business-day. For air bridge we can prepay duty/fees and invoice Redwood; expedite credit up to 30% on shipping surcharge after claim approval.
lee: Technical note: if we reassign US spares to EU, we must drain a subset of pods and requeue KV cache priming — this will cause brief cold-start latency. Also double-check Dedicated capacity pins if we move.
jordan: Priorities: Prod-critical canary customers > internal test fleets. If we touch Dedicated pools, schedule during a low-traffic window. Ops-oncall prefers a 02:00-05:00 UTC window.
maria: Cost math please. If we use loaners we avoid customs delays but risk mismatched perf profile (H100 vs H200 power / firmware). Any checklist for compatibility?
alex: Quick check list I ran:
```
serials_mismatch = ["H100-AX12-0043","H100-AX12-0044","H200-BX90-1101",...]
check_fw = vendor_api.get_firmware(serials)
compat_ok = True if all(model in allowed_models_eu) else False
```
Compatibility: vendor says loaners are H100 equivalent; firmware patching can be done in-depot.
sam: If loaners -> need depot acceptance photos + AWB and temporary manifest. I'll draft customs paperwork, share template.
ops-bot: Tracking update: AWB QZ12345 assigned by NexaSupply. Status: label created. ETA 2024-08-21 06:00 UTC.
alex: Proposal: take vendor loaners for immediate relief (6 units AMS ship), initiate cross-region air for 2 high-priority replacements from US (express) to replenish US pool, and open reorder for 12 replacements with vendor lead-time calendar.
maria: +1 to loaners. Schedule firmware patching in depot, then CNAME rollout to avoid perf regressions. Sam, can you confirm depot SLA and acceptance window?
sam: Depot confirms 72h acceptance window for loaners; photos + serial manifest required. I'll post the manifest to the ticket by EOD.
lee: I'll prepare a short canary plan and a batch rollout script. Need names of the 2 customers to avoid hitting their pc thresholds.
jordan: I'll block the 02:00-05:00 UTC maintenance window tomorrow. Flag me if we hit >30% retry errors.
alex: I'll confirm with vendor on reimburse timeline and get a written credit memo. Also raising procurement PO for replacements + expedite line. Saving decision: loaners + 2x express US->EU bridge. Creating tracking ticket INF-4529.
maria: Thanks — please @alex attach AWB and vendor credit memo in INF-4529. :thumbsup:
nexasupply-rep: Will upload invoice + credit memo to the ticket once AWB scans are complete. Ping me if customs needs HS code clarification. :wave:
alex: Noted. End state: EU pool backfilled with vendor loaners within 48h, US pool topped by 2 express units, procurement order placed for 12 replacements. Follow-ups in INF-4529.
